hypothesis.statement: A repository revision alone cannot reproduce reconstruction because mutable or partial model blobs and unknown worker capabilities can silently change geometry.
hypothesis.action: Allowlist exact weight files, pin revision, byte length and LFS SHA-256, require Linux/CUDA/disk evidence, forbid symlinked blobs and reject overclaimed worker readiness.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Only a verified worker snapshot can feed the six-candidate benchmark, while large blobs stay outside Git and the local Mac.

validation: reject incomplete or extra snapshot files
reject readiness while TRELLIS snapshot remains unpinned
decision: Keep the handoff contract. Do not download multi-gigabyte snapshots locally or claim worker readiness until land is reachable and both official snapshots validate.
